title.id: Raiden Visuals Standard Edition v2.4 UPDATE!
title.en: Raiden Visuals Standard Edition v2.4 UPDATE!

summary.id: Kompatibel dengan Minecraft Bedrock Stable 26.51+, pembaruan Pack Icon, konfigurasi refleksi, dan dukungan awal Block Light/Point Light di PC.
summary.en: Compatible with Minecraft Bedrock Stable 26.51+, updated pack icon, refined reflection configuration, and initial Block Light/Point Light support on PC.

warning.id: PERINGATAN GPU EXTENDED DAN SHADER MATERIAL BIN TIDAK TERMASUK!
warning.en: WARNING: EXTENDED GPU AND SHADER MATERIAL BIN ARE NOT INCLUDED!

items.id: Kompatibel Dengan Minecraft Bedrock Versi Stable 26.51+
items.en: Compatible With Minecraft Bedrock Stable Version 26.51+

items.id: Kompatibel Dengan Fitur Block Light/Point Light (Hanya Support PC + Untested)
items.en: Compatible With Block Light/Point Light Feature (PC Only + Untested)

items.id: Memperbarui Konfigurasi Platform Bagian Deferred Mixed Resolution Menjadi "0.5"
items.en: Updated Deferred Mixed Resolution Platform Configuration To "0.5"

items.id: Untuk Android Memerlukan Aplikasi Pihak Ketiga Seperti MB Loader, Levi Launcher, Ambient dan Flarial Client.
items.en: For Android, you'll need a third-party app such as MB Loader, Levi Launcher, Ambient, or Flarial Client.

items.id: Untuk Windows Cukup Timpa Folder "Renderer" Ke "C:\XboxGames\Minecraft for Windows\Content\data".
items.en: For Windows, simply overwrite the "Renderer" folder into "C:\XboxGames\Minecraft for Windows\Content\data".

items.id: Backup dulu sebelum menimpa, seperti kompres dulu folder renderer originalnya.
items.en: Back up first before overwriting — for example, compress the original renderer folder beforehand.
